mapper.select: SELECT ui.uid, ui.username, IFNULL(col.name, '-') AS college, IFNULL(cls.name, '-') AS majorClass FROM user_info ui LEFT JOIN sys_college col ON col.id = ui.college_id LEFT JOIN sys_class cls ON cls.id = ui.class_id WHERE (ui.uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR ui.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR ui.realname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY ui.gmt_create DESC
